BL-767 — DEFECT — a question queued while the bridge is busy is answered in the Cursor Remote topic, not the topic it was asked in
What it solves: Severity `medium`, deliberately: the answer is misrouted to a sibling topic in
the same Telegram group rather than lost, and only on the busy path. See
approval_context — the human may reasonably call it `high`, and the Article
3.2.4 expedite lane follows whatever `severity:` ends up saying.
Approval context: Two calls, both cheap to reverse, neither blocking the main fix.
First, the busy cue. BL-764 ships a standing edit-in-place "busy / N waiting" line, and `telegramCursorBridgeLiveness.ts:33` renders it only on Cursor Remote. If a Bubble-asked question is going to be answered in Bubble, the cue that …
BL-767 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-767" (or "reject BL-767 <reason>") to act.
